description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: A personal assistant connecting knowledge, research, and action for Pi, DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and Antigravity.
AI 写作工作台：远程Claude与Codex（主机常驻进程，经 aw-acp 接回），员工电脑文件由主机 agent 经 ssh 操作。
星野计划（by Sirius YANG）：按 18 类天象与深空目标、全国 173 站、最长一年检索，结合光污染、方位、月相、星历事件与 7 天天气，给出推荐排序、地景、焦段与曝光；每条结果附 Stellarium 风格 3D 天球画面模拟（真实银河等值线、真实月相、实测天际线）。
鲸聊 - 不只是手机遥控操作电脑,而是将电脑级的Agent能力装进手机

Monitor 数据搬运工作室:左侧导航独立入口,把一个 Monitor 公司的数据(主数据/BOM/未结订单/库存快照/附加字段)经官方 API 搬进另一个 Monitor 系统,跨版本不动表结构/角色/权限。自带进程内引擎(源库直读+目标API写入)与操作手册。A sidebar-entry data transfer studio for DeepSeek Harness: moves one Monitor company into another via official APIs only.

Live DeepSeek API token price bar for the web GUI: peak/off-peak tariff, UTC + local (Quebec) clocks, countdown to the next tariff change, and a daily self-verification against the official DeepSeek pricing page.

Plugin-authoring skill for DeepSeek Harness: the distilled anatomy, client-UI recipe, slots, locale, theme tokens, install steps, gotchas, and validation checklist for building and publishing new DSH plugins.
DSH 网页版桌面宠物「肥鲸」——蓝发鲸鱼娘，固定在 harness 页面右下角：会眨眼、能拖拽、点击可聊天，支持语音对话、念诗说书、饭点提醒。
鱼搭子 · DSH 这半边：桌面小挂件说的话送进你绑定的会话，她的回话再递回挂件。挂件是独立程序，这里只负责接线。

Lists this session's failures as copyable cards in the conversation view, attributes each to a cause, and carries the next step: fix the cause in place, copy paste-ready repair commands, or mark it resolved — the panel ticks itself off once a verified fix is reported.
Pure 子插件：gradle_run 工具、工作区内直接执行、工作区外目录审批与全局白名单
在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。
Use peer-to-peer inference on the GenKaKu network

DSH bundle that mounts the wensu (文溯) MCP server over stdio: CNKI and Web of Science search with impact factors, plus full-text reading of the paper in the browser you are already signed in to. Read-only, no PDF downloads.
AgentKit Studio product plugin with an independent TypeScript provider for the official DSH host.
Free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): native dsh-llm adapter plugin, no API key.
Cut DSH token usage by projecting tool receipts and substituting deterministic read-only calls.

Deep PTC for DeepSeek Harness: interruptible jobs, selectable shells, uncapped interactive cards, high-capacity project cards, a task brief that verifies acceptance as the work proceeds, deep sleep mode for unattended runs, adjustable alert sounds with your own audio, on-demand tools and skills, an…
Feishu/Lark workbench for DeepSeek Harness: build a Base from one sentence, or run calendar, tasks, chat, mail, and contacts from the sidebar.
MCP 管理（全局 / 项目）：直接编辑 mcp.yml，项目级 MCP 挂在会话自己的 Agent 作用域里，改完热生效
PR and release workspace for DSH: grouped pull requests, file diffs, review comments, CI checks, and an evidence-backed release chain from merged PR to the live market index.
Diagnose why a model provider is unavailable in DeepSeek Harness: host, plugin, registration, client, credentials and catalog evidence in one read-only report.
Per-session DeepSeek API cost meter with adaptive peak/off-peak (波峰/波谷) tariff
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.
Engineering bundle: Studio 5000 L5X, FactoryTalk View ME, FactoryTalk Optix, MotionWorks IEC, DXF/DWG drawing previews and RSLogix 500/5 migration - one install, one row per toolchain.
MCP server for DeepSeek Harness sessions — list, read and prompt live conversations from any MCP client

Cherry Studio-style knowledge base system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): bases, documents, chunking, embeddings (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama / local / lexical fallback), retrieval, model-facing tools, and a browser management panel
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。
灵枢（Lingshu·líng shū）DeepSeek Harness 插件：完整大脑——长期记忆/知识飞轮/自我认知/递归反思接入 DSH，对话自动沉淀进 md_cg 认知图（md 文档）

云端同步 0.12.6：修「用户删掉默认工作区后，同步又把它重建出来」——布局 key 是小写路径、本机默认工作区路径是大写，`path.resolve` 不统一大小写导致跳过判断失效；改为 Windows 下不区分大小写比较（samePathLoose），默认工作区不再由同步创建/恢复。0.12.5：兜底挂载/空孤儿清理不再要求「本轮必须合并到新会话」，普通一轮同步就会执行（删掉工作区后点同步即可看到清理结果）。0.12.4：孤儿判定新增「悬空工作区记录」——布局里的工作区被标记删除、或它的 id 已不在本机注册表（且同路径没有活着的工作区）时，其会话也算无归属，配合 0.12.3 清理空…
DSH 多智能体协作平台
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

DeepSeek Harness 换肤插件（Dream Skin for DSH）：8 套 iOS / Linear 式清透冷调的高质感主题 + 弥散光壁纸 + 每皮肤智能背景 + 强调色 + 主题包分享，把换肤做成材质与配色克制的高级感工艺，而非贴图。Works in native DSH Web and third-party desktop clients (DSH Desktop): 8 original premium themes, glass materials, wallpaper 2.0, per-user accent, shareable theme packs — p…
T Expert — a 636-expert, 22-division roster with full Chinese translations, as a standalone DeepSeek Harness plugin.
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
OpenCode Zen 免费模型面板插件：实时展示 OpenCode Zen 最新免费模型，一键置入 DSH 模型选择器，无需密钥即用（共享字面量密钥由宿主注入）。后台支持总开关 / 单模型下架管理。

Cut token cost without cutting model intelligence — a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) bundle plugin: structure-aware compression + TOON-style lossless encoding first + reversible spill-to-disk + real-time dashboard.
Pure 子插件：云效工作项（任务 / 缺陷 / 需求、Agent 委派与自动处理）+ Codeup 代码组 / 代码库 / 文件 / 提交浏览
Pure 子插件：飞书任务（基座飞书凭证中心、任务分组、按 Agent 名称的自动分组、轮询派发智能体）
Pure 子插件：ktorpure server 工程登记与元信息、实体变更（controller 基线 / SQL / 路由绑定）、消息占位翻译、开发指导 AGENTS.md、初始化向导、工程校验
Pure 子插件：MySQL 连接配置与只读查询（mysql_connections / mysql_ping / mysql_query）
Pure 子插件：npm 发布（账号 Access Token 绑定、会话级多项目绑定、prepack 预检、只做暂存发布并自动打开 Staged Packages 批准）
Pure 插件基座：Agent 名称配置、全局轮询器（常开）、设置页入口与设置 tab 插槽、业务页面插槽（由基座映射到右侧栏）、全局/工作区配置存储规范、子插件版本契约
Pure 子插件：SSH 服务器配置与远程命令执行（ssh_connections）
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备

Monitor BI 报表工作室:左侧导航栏独立入口,点进去就是 Harness 原生对话,但该房间只做 Monitor BI 报表(上下文干净、不与日常对话混杂)。自带零安装 CLI 工具链、操作手册、模板、数据字典;首次使用自动询问连接信息。A clean, sidebar-entry BI-only room for DeepSeek Harness with bundled tools, manual, templates and dictionary.

Presmium's bundle for DeepSeek Harness: the workbench of presmium studio, its host side (Presmium's tools, approvals, document context, skills and routes) and its client side (the root layout and the workbench's panels, precompiled) (experimental)
Managed MCP server settings for adding MCP servers

Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …
DSH agent preset「破甲」：CTF/逆向/渗透多域技术操作员（海鸥）。一行 bundle 声明，装完即出现在新会话的预设选择器里。

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
Пакеты Plexus DSH одним бандлом: метр, тёплый кэш, обрезка чтений и разведчик ставятся DSH одной строкой.
ZeroWall Science cloud, branding and plugin discovery for official DSH profiles
